name: Crucible Game Server
author: developer@crucible.game
description: Crucible 1v1 RTS Game Server with automatic GitHub auto-update on startup.
startup: if [ -d ".git" ] || [ -n "{{GIT_ADDRESS}}" ]; then git fetch --all && git reset --hard origin/{{GIT_BRANCH}}; fi && npm install && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run start -w server

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Crucible Installation Script

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git curl nodejs npm

cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  echo "Cloning repository: ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
  git clone -b ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

echo "Installing dependencies..."
npm install

echo "Building game server..."
npm run build -w shared
npm run build -w server

echo "Installation complete!"

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: The HTTP(S) URL of the Crucible GitHub repository to pull updates from.

variables.description: The branch to fetch and checkout (e.g. main or master).
